response.text: I'll look at those anomalies in detail, plus the AP journal and payment structure.

arguments.sql:
SELECT 'unbal' k, l."JRNL_NO"::text a, sum("DR_AMT")::text b, sum("CR_AMT")::text c, NULL d FROM "GLJRNL" l GROUP BY l."JRNL_NO" HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")
UNION ALL SELECT 'badacct', l."JRNL_NO"::text, '['||l."ACCT_CD"||']', l."DR_AMT"::text, l."CR_AMT"::text FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" c WHERE c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'outside_prd', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."POST_DT"::text, h."PRD_ID"::text, h."MEMO" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT" OR p."CLOSE_DT" IS NOT NULL AND h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'paidmismatch', i."INV_ID"::text, i."INV_AMT"::text, (SELECT sum("PAY_AMT") FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")::text, i."INV_NO" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."STAT_CD"='P' AND i."INV_AMT" <> (SELECT coalesce(sum("PAY_AMT"),0) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")
UNION ALL SELECT 'neginv', i."INV_ID"::text, i."INV_AMT"::text, i."STAT_CD", i."INV_NO" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_AMT"<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'ap_line', l."JRNL_NO"::text, '['||l."ACCT_CD"||']', l."DR_AMT"::text, l."CR_AMT"::text FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO" IN (1000, 2334, 2400, 2486)
SELECT h."SRC_CD", l."ACCT_CD", count(*) n, sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr, count(DISTINCT h."JRNL_NO") j FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING ("JRNL_NO") GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT (SELECT min("INV_DT") FROM "APINVH") mn_inv, (SELECT max("INV_DT") FROM "APINVH") mx_inv, (SELECT min("PAY_DT") FROM "APPAYM") mn_pay, (SELECT max("PAY_DT") FROM "APPAYM") mx_pay, (SELECT min("POST_DT") FROM "GLJRNH") mn_post, (SELECT max("POST_DT") FROM "GLJRNH") mx_post, (SELECT count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE "SRC_CD"='AP' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO")) ap_jrnl_no_inv, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING ("JRNL_NO") WHERE h."SRC_REF"<>i."VEND_CD"||'-'||i."INV_NO"||'-1' AND h."SRC_REF" NOT LIKE 'PAY-%') srcref_mismatch, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."PAY_DT"<(SELECT "INV_DT" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID")) pay_before_inv, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_DT"::text !~ '^20[0-9]{2}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])[0-3][0-9]$') bad_dates
